data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Antonios, which means 'priceless' or 'precious'. In Christian tradition, the name Antons is associated with Saint Antoninus of Florence, a humble and compassionate monk who lived in the 14th century. The name Antons carries the meaning “Graceful, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Antons usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
